properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (measured, 0.92.0): a change's redo_list fills `drawings` and `models` only through an Artifact REALIZES a reached Component; a sheet or model that DOCUMENTS the part is never reached, while the reply's own note says "what a record documents" counts, so a designer who drew DOCUMENTS edges got empty buckets
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-26, on a flo2 trial: a designer worked an owner's change (remove two basement units and the storage) through a sample apartment building design on flo2.io (reflow2 0.92.0).

① OBSERVED (the trial agent's words): with no explicit edges propagation did not reach shoring, dewatering, sheets or the model; "even after drawing DOCUMENTS edges from sheet artifacts to the seed components, redo_list.drawings/models/computations stayed EMPTY". NOT affected: `parts` filled (DEPENDS_ON between parts).

② PRECEDENT: reflow2:fact:root-cause-a-changed-requirement-does-not-flow-because-the-accepted-web-of-rules-was-never-built-2026-10-25 (the redo list did not exist; built 10-25 as reflow2:cap:a-change-returns-its-redo-list, "by kind, not yet by trade"). No finding on which edge fills which bucket.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) redo_list reads only REALIZES for drawings/models and DOCUMENTS only outward from an Artifact; (b) the sheets' artifact_type is not one output_kind maps to drawing ("document", "pdf"); (c) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2's door changed or dropped the redo_list; (d) the observation is wrong (the agent seeded nodes the edges do not touch).

④–⑤ MEASURED, read-only, on the trial design through flo2.io (propagate_from, max_depth 2): the sheet artifacts are artifact_type `drawing` (b refuted for them). art:sheets-dewatering has REALIZES → the temporary-works discipline and DOCUMENTS → the dewatering system; the IFC model has only DOCUMENTS → the basement walls. Seeds walls, slab, the two unit types and temporary-works: redo_list.drawings = [the dewatering sheets] "because it realizes" temporary-works, models = [] (the model only DOCUMENTS the walls), computations = [] and quantities = [], parts filled (6). So a REALIZES reaches the drawings bucket through the door, and a DOCUMENTS does not: (a) holds, (c) refuted (the door passes the redo_list whole), (d) refuted for these seeds. Source: owed.rs v0.92.0 lines ~622-760 (see cause_evidence). computations stay empty for a second reason: the two calc records flo2-calc kept (artifact_type `data`) name no inputs (no DEPENDS_ON with a used basis), so no kept output took a seed as input.

⑥ CLASS: the reply's note names an edge kind (DOCUMENTS) the walk does not follow in the direction a designer draws it, so the instruction and the code disagree and nothing checks the note against the walk. A designer reaches for DOCUMENTS for a drawing of a part, which is what the edge means.

RECOMMENDED, by correctness: (1) reflow2: walk incoming DOCUMENTS from an Artifact of kind drawing/model to a reached Component as well as REALIZES (a sheet that documents a part is redrawn when the part changes), and state each bucket's edges and direction in REDO_NOTE; pin it with a test that seeds a part documented by a drawing and a model and expects both buckets filled (it fails today). (2) Until then, say in the note that only REALIZES fills drawings/models. (3) flo2-calc / flo2: a kept calc names its inputs (it can since flo2-calc 0.13.0, not deployed) so `computations` fills.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the exact seeds and edges the trial agent used (its edges were read afterwards, not at the time); whether trade grouping would change it. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
